scientific_purpose: Separate training class prevalence from the decision objective: prespecified bootstrap-MCC thresholds at hypothetical priors .03/.07/.12 and observed-label prevalence, using the same fresh 20-epoch class network and potency gate fits. Fully nested five-model decision transfer, no 49-call constraint, no old model inputs.
selection_rule: Report every prior policy with matching hypothetical held-out prior-adjusted MCC; no scenario is asserted to be the unknown blind prevalence. Model/threshold fitting excludes held-out groups and all their assays. Outputs include fitted inner cuts and keyed calls. No upload.
limitations: Label-shift calculations require class-conditional score transfer; primary selection violates coverage, so hypothetical projected MCC is not identified blind accuracy. No unknown labels are assigned negative. Protocol/fit uncertainty exceeds conditional bootstrap intervals.
